name: Afinação Suprema da Fluidez — Chama Trançada, Portais e Whit Segura
macro_stage: Macroetapa V504 — Afinação Suprema da Fluidez
scope: Refinamento do Tarot Livre V503 e do Menu Orbital V502 após inspeção real da versão instalada, sem substituir o núcleo físico da Orbe V501.

canonical_orb.behavior: The one physical living orb is claimed from Home by Tarot or Menu and always returned to the same Home cradle.

stellar_flame.webgl: Wider, brighter, more sinuous gold-magenta-violet ribbon with three living filaments.
stellar_flame.canvas_fallback: Three genuinely braided S-shaped stellar strands with glow, hot core and adaptive quality.
stellar_flame.birth_wave: A luminous particle wave travels from the physical orb to the principal card and opens a crown burst at insertion time.

fluidity.menu_visual_response: The cosmic veil appears on the first animation frame, including when returning from an inner world to Home.

whit_safe_zone.desktop: Whit remains visible on the right without covering the central altar.
whit_safe_zone.mobile: Whit becomes a compact luminous presence above the dock.
whit_safe_zone.during_card_birth: Whit softens temporarily so the orb-to-card ritual remains visually unobstructed.

tarot_rules.reset_confirmation: two taps when the circle contains revealed cards
